{{Quote|Nok Drayen was the greatest gangster who ever lived. He personally wiped out the Rath Cartel and the Vandelhelm Combine during the Syndicate Wars.|[[Risha Drayen]]|<ref name="Codex" />}}
The '''Vandelhelm Combine''' was a criminal organization active at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Considered an upstart by its rival, the [[Rath Cartel]], the Combine was in the business of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] weapons and hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in its efforts to compete with the Cartel.<ref name="Codex" />

However,<ref name="Codex" /> sometime between [[3667 BBY]] and [[3661 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the fighting&mdash;which became known as the [[Syndicate Wars]]&mdash;spilled over into a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade corridor]] controlled by the notorious [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Nok Drayen]], who swiftly retaliated against both groups in order to protect his profits; Drayen called in favors from [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] mercenaries, [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and officials from the Sith Empire to destroy them. The Syndicate Wars ultimately ended when Drayen had the [[Rath Cartel leader|leader]] of the Rath Cartel [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] while simultaneously storming the Combine's headquarters, and Drayen took all of their profits for himself in the aftermath.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vandelhelm Combine was first mentioned in several companion conversations in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Race">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Race the Devil|Coruscant}}</ref> The Combine shares its name with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]];<ref name="Codex" /> however, the [[2004]] [[Wizards.com]] article "[[Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys]]: Part 1: File Vandelhelm-LC/hsnn" establishes that the planet was not discovered until approximately [[3053 BBY]],<ref name="Vandel">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw200403041vandelhelm|series=Vandelhelm: Enemies and Alloys|text=Part 1: File Vandelhelm-LC/hsnn}} states that [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]] was discovered 22,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|founding]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' dates to [[25,053 BBY]]. Thus, Vandelhelm was discovered in approximately [[3053 BBY]].</ref> six hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the Syndicate Wars.<ref name="Time" />
